name: Riverside Family Medicine (synthetic demo practice)
hours: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM. Closed weekends and public holidays.
location: One demo address, 100 Example Street. This is a synthetic practice used for testing.
services: Primary care visits, annual physicals, follow-up visits, vaccinations, and lab draws by appointment.
new_patient: New patients can book a new patient visit once the caller is verified.
after_hours: For emergencies call 911. For urgent questions after hours, leave a message and a staff member will call back the next business day.
cancellation: Please give at least 24 hours notice to cancel or move a visit.
insurance: Insurance questions are handled by the billing team. Take a message for them.
